verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (18:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: Rey Cortiço after work (18:30 start) looks like the best available option, but the wind angle is pretty poor for that spot and it’s getting a low-confidence kind of window. Surfline is reading rough, so I’d do a cam check on Surfline and MEO Beachcam first before committing, since the sandbanks can shift fast there. If the cams don’t look much cleaner than expected, I’d skip it—otherwise, go with low expectations and just aim for workable sets.
